北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天有霾且体感寒冷，请注意保暖和呼吸道防护哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Hazy and feeling cold in Beijing today. Please keep warm and protect your respiratory system.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪今日有雨，湿度大，记得带伞，注意防潮哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: It's rainy and humid in Cixi today. Don't forget your umbrella and stay dry!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨体感冷，出门记得带伞，多穿衣物保暖哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and chilly in Shanghai. Remember your umbrella and dress warmly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天但体感温暖，早晚温差大，注意适时添减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy but warm in Guangzhou. Mind the temperature difference between morning and night.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感舒适，记得备件薄外套，以防早晚微凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and comfortable in Shenzhen. Keep a light jacket handy for cooler mornings/evenings.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨体感湿冷，出门带伞，多穿暖和衣物，小心路滑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Light rain and damp cold in Hangzhou. Take an umbrella, dress warmly, and watch for slippery roads.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雨夹雪体感很冷，注意保暖防湿滑，出行要慢行哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sleet and very cold in Nanjing. Keep warm, watch for slippery conditions, and drive carefully.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感略凉，早晚温差大，注意添衣别着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu and feeling a bit cool. Big temperature difference, so add layers to avoid catching a cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天体感湿冷，风力大，请您多穿衣物，注意防风保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and damp cold in Wuhan with strong winds. Please dress warmly and stay windproof.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感微凉，记得穿暖和点，小心感冒哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly cool in Xi'an. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，湿度大，出行请注意交通安全，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Foggy and humid in Chongqing. Please drive safely and pay attention to moisture.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感极寒，请务必多穿最厚实的冬衣，防冻保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Extremely cold in Harbin! Make sure to wear your warmest winter clothes to prevent frostbite and stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但体感寒冷，请注意防寒保暖，别着凉哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but cold in Shenyang. Please keep warm and prevent catching a cold.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚体感舒适，紫外线较强，请注意防晒补水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant in Kunming, but UV is strong. Remember sun protection and hydration.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天体感舒适，早晚微凉，备件薄外套哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and comfortable in Xiamen. Slightly cool morning/evening, so keep a light jacket.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感寒冷，风力较大，请注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cold in Qingdao with strong winds. Please stay warm and windproof.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感很冷，出门记得多穿，做好防寒措施。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and very cold in Dalian. Remember to bundle up and take cold protection measures.
